name.es: Motor a pasos NEMA 17, cuerpo de 48 mm
name.fr: Moteur pas à pas NEMA 17, corps de 48 mm
name.pt: Motor de passo NEMA 17, corpo de 48 mm

description.en: A 1.8° hybrid stepper in the NEMA 17 frame size with a 48 mm body: four M3 tapped holes on a 31 mm square around a Ø22 mm pilot, and a Ø5 mm output shaft. It mates a motor bracket by its face and a pulley or coupler by its shaft.
description.es: Un motor a pasos híbrido de 1.8° en tamaño NEMA 17 con cuerpo de 48 mm: cuatro barrenos roscados M3 en un cuadrado de 31 mm alrededor de un piloto de Ø22 mm, y una flecha de salida de Ø5 mm. Se une a un soporte de motor por su cara y a una polea o un cople por su flecha.
description.fr: Un moteur pas à pas hybride de 1,8° au format NEMA 17 avec un corps de 48 mm : quatre trous taraudés M3 sur un carré de 31 mm autour d'un centrage de Ø22 mm, et un arbre de sortie de Ø5 mm. Il se fixe à un support moteur par sa face et reçoit une poulie ou un accouplement sur son arbre.
description.pt: Um motor de passo híbrido de 1,8° no tamanho NEMA 17 com corpo de 48 mm: quatro furos roscados M3 num quadrado de 31 mm em volta de um piloto de Ø22 mm, e um eixo de saída de Ø5 mm. Fixa-se a um suporte de motor pela face e recebe uma polia ou um acoplamento no eixo.

governing.designation: NEMA 17 (NEMA ICS 16 frame size 17) stepper, 48 mm body — LDO-42STH48-2004AC(VRN) Rev B

sources.title: LDO Motors NEMA17 stepper motor LDO-42STH48-2004AC(VRN) drawing, Rev B (copy in a public Voron users repository, pinned)
sources.supports: 48 max body; 42.3 max face; 4-M3 deep 4.5 min on 31 ±0.1; pilot Ø22 (0/−0.052) × 2.0; shaft Ø5, 24 ±0.5 long (Rev B), flat 20 long; 1.8° step; 0.35 kg

sources.title: Nanotec ST4118 (NEMA 17) stepper motor product overview
sources.supports: NEMA 17 face 42.3 mm, 4× M3 on 31 ±0.2 mm, Ø22 (0/−0.05) pilot, Ø5 shaft 24 ±0.5 mm

frame_convention: Origin at the centre of the mounting face (the flange face carrying the four M3 holes), on the shaft axis. +z runs along the shaft, out of the face, toward the bracket the face is bolted to; the body occupies −48 ≤ z ≤ 0 and the pilot boss 0 ≤ z ≤ 2. +x and +y are parallel to the sides of the 31 mm hole square, so the holes sit at (±15.5, ±15.5, 0).

body_length.note: maximum; the LDO product page states 48 mm

shaft_length.note: Rev B lengthened the shaft to 24 mm; Nanotec's ST4118 drawing gives the same

label.es: Asiento del cubo en la flecha

parameters.note: Where the partner's hub face seats along the shaft, measured from the face plane. Default: the 2.0 mm pilot height (a hub resting on the pilot); maximum: the 24 mm shaft length. A choice, not a fact.

interfaces.note: Female: tapped holes receive the fastener's thread.
Symmetry 0: the round shaft. The D-flat is not modelled as an orientation constraint; the partner's set screw finds it.

review_status.note: Drafted in one pass by an agent (P4-STD lane, 2026-10-02); facts read from the cited sources on the access date; no language facet has had a native review.

notes: The 48 mm body is the length class Voron 2.4 uses for its motors; the face, pilot and shaft facts are NEMA 17 facts that the Nanotec drawing confirms independently.
